description:
Incorporated in 1993, Som Distilleries & Breweries Ltd. is one of the leading alcoholic beverages manufacturers in India engaged in the manufacturing and sale of Beer and Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL). [1] [2]

Key Points:
Business Overview: [1] [2] The company is the flagship company of the Bhopal-based Som Group and is engaged in the production of beer and the blending and bottling of IMFL. It is one of the leading alcoholic beverage manufacturers in India .
